title: Post Enhancer Panel
description: Build the PRISM Post Enhancer panel for hyperMILL. After NC generation, the panel offers per-block variable speed/feed enhancement via the 38-stage PostProcessorPipelineEngine (PPP). Shows side-by-side comparison of original vs PPP-optimized G-code with cycle time delta, peak force comparison, and tool life improvement estimate. Controller-specific verification ensures the enhanced output is safe for the target CNC.

forge_triple.hook: hm-plugin:post-enhance-safety-gate — BUILT (validates enhanced G-code against machine limits before write)
forge_triple.action: hypermill_plugin:enhance_nc_output — BUILT (runs PPP 38-stage on generated NC file)
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-post-enhancer — BUILT (enhance hyperMILL NC output with per-block variable S/F)

sessions.title: PPP Integration + Side-by-Side Comparison
sessions.intent: Wire PostProcessorPipelineEngine to accept hyperMILL NC output, run per-block S/F optimization, and produce a side-by-side comparison with cycle time and force deltas.

units.title: PPP NC Enhancement Action
units.description: Create hypermill_plugin:enhance_nc_output action that takes a hyperMILL-generated NC file path, parses it through PPP's 38-stage pipeline with per-block Kienzle force recalculation, and outputs an enhanced NC file with variable S/F. Map hyperMILL's post-processor output format to PPP input schema. Handle controller-specific G-code dialects (Fanuc, Siemens, Heidenhain, Okuma) via HyperMillControllerCatalogEngine.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: PPP processes hyperMILL NC file and outputs enhanced version with per-block variable S/F
Controller dialect detection correctly identifies Fanuc/Siemens/Heidenhain/Okuma from G-code header
Enhanced output validates against target controller's G-code syntax rules

units.title: Side-by-Side Comparison Engine
units.description: Build the comparison engine that aligns original and enhanced NC files block-by-block. Calculate deltas for: cycle time (integration of feed distances / feed rates), peak cutting force (Kienzle per block), estimated tool life improvement (Taylor equation ratio). Generate summary statistics and per-block diff view with color coding (green=improved, yellow=neutral, red=degraded).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Block-by-block alignment handles tool changes, rapid moves, and sub-programs correctly
Cycle time delta calculated with <1% error vs actual feed integration
Tool life improvement estimate uses Taylor equation with material-specific n exponent

sessions.exit_gate: PPP enhances hyperMILL NC output + comparison engine produces valid deltas | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Post Enhancer Panel UI + Verification
sessions.intent: Build the Post Enhancer HTML/JS panel with side-by-side code view, delta summary cards, and controller-specific verification status badge.

units.title: Post Enhancer Panel HTML/JS UI
units.description: Build the Post Enhancer panel with: 'Enhance with per-block variable S/F?' button, side-by-side G-code viewer with syntax highlighting and diff coloring, summary cards showing cycle time delta (%), peak force delta (%), tool life improvement (%), and controller-specific verification badge (pass/fail with dialect name).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Side-by-side viewer shows original (left) and enhanced (right) with line-level diff highlighting
Summary cards display cycle time savings, force reduction, and tool life gain as percentages
Controller verification badge shows green checkmark with dialect name (e.g., 'Fanuc 30i verified')

units.title: Controller Verification + Write-Back
units.description: Implement controller-specific verification that checks enhanced G-code against machine limits (max RPM, max feed, axis limits, supported G-codes). Add 'Accept & Replace' button that overwrites the original NC file with the enhanced version (with backup). Add 'Export Report' for the comparison summary as PDF. Test with 4 controller dialects.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Verification checks max RPM, max feed rate, and supported G-code set for target controller
Accept & Replace creates timestamped backup of original before overwriting
4 controller dialect tests pass (Fanuc 30i, Siemens 840D, Heidenhain TNC 640, Okuma OSP)

sessions.exit_gate: Panel shows side-by-side diff + 4 controller verifications pass + write-back works | omega_floor >= 0.90
